# ANL-10: Example

**Priority:** Core
**State:** 🟢 Implemented

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The system does the thing.

## Decisions it realizes

The transport comes from [[../../01_adr/adr-x|the transport decision]], written the
way prose cites an ADR — the left side is the target and the right side is a phrase
a human reads. Reading the right side finds no ADR, so the maturity claim goes
unchecked and the mismatch below is never reported.
